verdict.rationale: Drata documents a Public APIv2 with an OpenAPI-style reference covering create/update/delete operations across controls, policies, evidence library, frameworks, monitoring tests, custom connections, devices, personnel, audits and risks, plus OAuth setup docs, so the product can be driven programmatically. The 404 probes on common spec paths do not contradict the documented reference; they only show the raw machine-readable spec was not found at those URLs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, and a raw OpenAPI spec file at a discoverable path (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
